product_name: de Buyer Mineral B Pro Carbon Steel

indicators.label: Has no coating to degrade, avoiding the microplastic-shedding failure mode documented in PTFE-coated pans (the reviewer cites a University of Newcastle 2022 study measuring roughly 9,100 microplastic particles released per cooking cycle from a single scratch in PTFE coating) — though this is evidence about a category risk being avoided by construction, not a direct environmental test of this product
indicators.source: Clarity Insight Advisory (Buy Better With Brian)

people.label: People & Supply Chain
people.note: No source addresses this dimension at any level. Asks the enterprise to disclose.

indicators.label: One of only two cookware lines (of 180+ rated) to earn a 10/10 chemistry-safety rating, based on manufacturer PTFE/PFOA-free disclosure for its uncoated 99% iron / 1% carbon construction
indicators.source: Clarity Insight Advisory (Buy Better With Brian)

indicators.label: Rated above competing carbon steel brands (Lodge 7/10, OXO 6/10, IKEA VARDAGEN 6/10, Made In 8/10) on finish quality and long-term ownership reports from r/carbonsteel and r/Cooking communities
indicators.source: Clarity Insight Advisory (Buy Better With Brian)

indicators.label: Requires initial seasoning, reacts with acidic foods until well-seasoned, and is not dishwasher-safe
indicators.source: Clarity Insight Advisory (Buy Better With Brian)

indicators.label: At $45-$90 for a skillet the reviewer expects to last 30+ years, cost works out to under $3/year, which the reviewer contrasts with a $25 T-Fal pan replaced annually
indicators.source: Clarity Insight Advisory (Buy Better With Brian)
